newsitem.title: KENYA: One dead in Kenya government building blast.
newsitem.headline: One dead in Kenya government building blast.

text.p: One person was killed in an explosion at a government building in Nairobi on Sunday morning, Kenyan radio said.
The blast, at the Bureau of Statistics in central Nairobi, happened at about 0400 local time, (0100 GMT), the radio said.
Police said the incident was under investigation and the cause of the explosion was not immediately known. It caused only slight damage to one room, they said.
The Bureau, which collects and publishes statistics on the economy and other subjects, closes over the weekend, and only a small security staff is on duty when it is closed, police said.
The Bureau adjoins the headquarters of the Kenya Finance Ministry and the Central Bank of Kenya. It is only a few yards away from the Kenya Police headquarters.
